paths.audience: Workday consultants, HR professionals, admins and business analysts

tools.summary: Atlassian's AI features are now Rovo. Learn through Atlassian's learning hub and take the free Rovo Fundamentals certificate. Jira Essentials is a related certification.
recommended_order: Atlassian Community Learning hub (Rovo and Jira courses)

paths.title: Atlassian Community Learning hub (Rovo and Jira courses)
paths.note: Page opened; lists on-demand learning by app (Jira, Rovo) and a certification-ready section.

paths.title: Rovo Fundamentals certificate
paths.note: Page opened: proves ability to use Rovo Search, Chat and Agents. Exam length and validity are not on the page.

paths.title: Jira Essentials certification
paths.note: Listed as 'Earn the Jira Essentials certification' under Related credentials on the Rovo page. Its own page (guessed URL) returned 404, so only the listing is confirmed.

tools.summary: UiPath Academy has free courses and learning plans plus agentic certifications. Agentic Automation Associate is the foundation level, and Agentic Automation Builder Professional validates building end-to-end agentic solutions. Pricing is not on the pages.
recommended_order: UiPath Academy courses and learning plans

paths.title: UiPath Academy courses and learning plans
paths.note: Page opened: advertises 500+ courses and an Agentic Automation Associate learning plan; the Community edition is free in Automation Cloud.

paths.title: Agentic Automation Associate
paths.audience: Citizen developers, business analysts, automation developers, solution architects
paths.note: Page opened: validates foundational skills for collaborating with AI agents; free online practice test offered.

paths.title: Agentic Automation Builder Professional
paths.note: Page opened: covers design, build, orchestration and operation of agentic solutions with Maestro and AI agents. The page also lists an intermediate Agentic Automation Professional certification.

groups.verification_notes: I opened the Salesforce, SAP (home and both Joule journeys), Atlassian, UiPath, Workday newsroom and igmGuru pages, and each confirmed its entry. The ServiceNow pages and the SAP Joule help page gave no usable content, so those entries stay unverified and ServiceNow confidence is low. No page showed exam price or duration, so all costs and durations are 'not stated' except Rovo Fundamentals, which the page calls free. Third-party figures were removed unless the vendor page shows them.
removed_or_corrected: Removed Workday customer learning (workday.com/en-us/learning-training.html): page returned HTTP 404 and a second guessed URL also 404'd.
Salesforce Agentforce Specialist: dropped the unconfirmed third-party duration and cost from the fields, because the vendor page shows neither.
SAP Driving SAP Joule for Consultants Adoption: opened the English URL and set verified=true (the earlier URL was the German version).
SAP Implementing Joule: removed the 'free' claim, since the page does not show cost.
Workday igmGuru course: opened and set verified=true for existence; removed the 24-hour figure and corrected the audience, as the page does not show the duration.
Jira Essentials: renamed to 'certification' to match the Atlassian listing; its own page returned 404, so only the Rovo page listing is confirmed.
UiPath: removed the unsupported claim that Autopilot and Studio Web are covered; added a note that Agentic Automation Professional also exists.
